item.tib: ri khrod chen po'i zhus len
item.coloph: ri khrod pa chen po la/ rmongs pa sprong (sprang) phrug cig gi (gis) zhus pa yin/ dad ldan brtson 'grus can gyi (gyis) gzigs smos mdzod/ gred po log lta can la gab rgya thob/ gzhan don phyir na yig ge ris su bkod/ mi 'thad yod srid mkha' 'gro rnams la bshags/ u ya/ ag tham/ gshen sras drung du bdag gis zhus//
